description.en: ActiveFly-Bench is a benchmark for UAV embodied perception, decomposing active perception into three tasks: Aerial Embodied Question Answering (Air-EQA), Observation Behavior Planning (OBP), and Fine-grained Language-guided UAV Control (FLUC). It includes datasets from real-world and simulated outdoor environments.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Active perception in UAVs requires bridging high-level reasoning with low-level control, which current VLMs and VLA models struggle with. This benchmark provides a testbed for embodied aerial intelligence, addressing the lack of benchmarks in this domain.
